note: Document registry for the supplied 2010-2011 Can-Am Spyder RT/RT-S source compilation (1,603 compilation pages). Page ranges below come from the source PDF's own embedded outline/bookmarks (read via PyMuPDF get_toc()) -- explicit source data, not a guessed offset, per BUILD.md section 5. The parts-catalogue group in BUILD.md section 3 is split into per-model-year entries here because the outline itself lists SE5/SM5/RT-622 parts catalogues as separate 2010 and 2011 sections rather than one contiguous block per catalogue. IMPORTANT: every document except DOC-SPYDER-SHOP is built on a font the source PDF embeds without a usable ToUnicode CMap -- pdfplumber (and PyMuPDF) cannot recover real characters from it, only unmapped glyph references or a scrambled substitution of the actual text. See each affected document's note and scripts/ingest/README.md.

documents.title: 2010-2011 Can-Am Spyder RT / RT-S Shop Manual
documents.note: Outline sub-sections: Table of Contents (5), Service Tools Index (27), Maintenance (33), Engine (41), Electronic Management System (295), Fuel System (369), Fuel Tank and Pump (415), Electrical System (439, includes a FUSES insert at 440), Drive System (578), Chassis (596), Technical Specifications (772). The only document with a normally-encoded font -- text extraction is reliable here. 80 pages remain queued for human review; spot checks show most are genuinely blank pages in the source (deliberate print-layout spacers) rather than diagrams -- OCR classification of the rest (blank vs. real diagram/photo needing visual retention) is in progress.

documents.title: RT-622 Trailer Shop Manual
documents.note: Outline: Spyder Trailer Service Manual (780) -- Table of Contents, Introduction, Maintenance Schedule, Wheels and Hubs, Lights and Harness, Procedures, RT 622 Trailer Specifications. The source font has no usable ToUnicode CMap (see documents.json-level note), so text came from OCR (scripts/ingest/ocr_extract_text.py: render each page to an image, run EasyOCR) rather than the PDF's text layer -- still UNVERIFIED, OCR is not perfect. 9 pages remain queued as genuine diagram/photo pages.
